blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Whether or not there is a prenuptial agreement between Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband Manases Carpio, the evidence presented during her impeachment trial is enough to merit a conviction. This statement came from impeachment prosecution panel spokesperson Robert Ace Barbers on Tuesday in a press briefing briefing at the Batasang Pambansa. Barbers noted that while the team is eager to see if the defense panel will resort to such a strategy when the trial resumes on November 9, it will not diminish the strength of the prosecution’s case.
